content: alexcrichton requested dicej for a review on PR #14559.

alexcrichton opened PR #14559 from alexcrichton:fix-cancel-when-backpressure to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit fixes an issue where a component subtask cancellation would hit bail_bug! if the destination instance was not currently enterable, for example due to backpressure. The fix here is to detect this situation and continue the loop through threads to process the rest of the cancellation like normal.
